agentic_ttt.headline: RSI: Learning during the task, without losing the way
agentic_ttt.headlineZh: RSI：在任务中学习，而不迷失方向
agentic_ttt.dek: Continuous test-time training inside an agent episode becomes a self-training loop. The useful question is what to learn from.
agentic_ttt.dekZh: 智能体回合中的连续测试时训练构成一个自训练闭环，真正要回答的是该从什么里学习。

keypoints.en: Continuous TTT in an agent episode is a self-training loop: every update changes the policy that produces the next update’s training text, so whether it helps depends on whether that text is new.
keypoints.zh: 智能体回合中的连续测试时训练是一个自训练闭环：每次更新都会改变生成下一段训练文本的策略，因此有用与否取决于这段文本是否新鲜。

keypoints.en: aTTT downweights the loss on tokens that appear in n-grams already used by earlier updates and leaves novel tokens fully weighted — a per-token novelty filter, not an on/off switch on whole updates.
keypoints.zh: aTTT 降低此前更新已使用过的 n-gram 内 token 的损失权重，新 token 保持满权重：这是逐 token 的新颖性过滤，而非对整次更新做取舍。

keypoints.en: +5.0 points on ALFWorld and +4.9 on SWE-bench Lite for 1.9× the no-TTT cost, with gains concentrated where the model already had the competence and drifted away from it.
keypoints.zh: ALFWorld +5.0、SWE-bench Lite +4.9，开销为不做测试时训练的 1.9 倍；收益集中在模型本已具备能力、却在长轨迹中漂移的任务上。

p: An agent can know how to solve a task and still lose it. As an episode lengthens, trajectories revisit states already explored, failed actions reappear verbatim, and strategies that worked twenty turns ago stop being sampled. The failure is not a missing capability; it is drift.

Test-time training looks like the obvious remedy: update the weights on whatever the agent just experienced. But in a multi-turn episode this is not a one-shot adaptation to a fixed prompt. Each gradient step changes the policy that generates the next batch of training text, so the agent becomes its own data source.

That loop is the object of study here. It helps while the episode keeps producing new information and it hurts once the agent is stuck generating the same text. Agentic Test-Time Training separates the two cases at token level and reports +5.0 points on ALFWorld and +4.9 on SWE-bench Lite for 1.9× the cost of not training at all.
pz: 智能体有能力解决一个任务，却仍可能在过程中把它做砸。随着回合变长，轨迹不断回到已经探索过的状态，失败动作原样复现，二十步之前还有效的策略不再被采样。问题不在于能力缺失，而在于漂移。
测试时训练看起来是现成的解法：用刚刚发生过的经验更新权重。但在多回合任务中，这不是对固定输入的一次性适配——每一步梯度都会改变生成下一段训练文本的策略，智能体由此变成了自己的数据来源。
本文研究的正是这个闭环。回合持续产出新信息时它带来帮助，智能体卡住、反复生成相同文本时它放大偏移。Agentic Test-Time Training 在 token 层面区分这两种情况，在 ALFWorld 上提升 5.0 个点、在 SWE-bench Lite 上提升 4.9 个点，代价是不做测试时训练时的 1.9 倍。

sections.h: The loop that test-time training creates
sections.hz: 测试时训练形成的闭环
p: Existing LLM test-time-training methods mostly adapt once, to a fixed input. An agent episode is different: the model acts, the environment responds, the model trains on that text, and the updated model acts again. The training distribution is now a function of the parameters being trained.

This is fine while the episode is informative. It is corrosive once the agent stalls: a stuck policy emits near-identical trajectories, training on them sharpens the same wrong attractor, and the next rollout repeats it more confidently. Novelty, not volume, is what makes an update worth making.

aTTT turns that into a weighting rule. For each token in an update, the method checks whether it occurs inside an n-gram already used by a previous update; if so, its contribution to the loss is reduced, and novel tokens keep full weight. Repetition is measured against the update history of the current episode, so the filter tracks this agent’s degradation rather than a global statistic.
pz: 已有的大模型测试时训练方法大多只针对固定输入适配一次。智能体回合不同：模型行动，环境回应，模型在这段文本上训练，更新后的模型再次行动——训练分布变成了被训练参数的函数。
回合仍在提供信息时这没有问题；一旦智能体卡住就会腐蚀自身：停滞的策略输出近乎相同的轨迹，在这些轨迹上训练只会强化同一个错误吸引子，下一次采样更自信地重复它。决定一次更新是否值得的不是数据量，而是新颖性。
aTTT 把这一点写成加权规则：对更新中的每个 token，检查它是否出现在此前某次更新已使用过的 n-gram 内，若是则降低其对损失的贡献，新 token 保留满权重。重复性针对当前回合的更新历史统计，因此过滤器跟踪的是这个智能体自身的退化，而非某个全局统计量。

sections.h: Three ways to decide what to learn from
sections.hz: 三种决定学什么的方式
p: What counts as experience is a separate design choice, and the paper treats the update signal as a variable: the agent’s own generated trajectory, the observations returned by the environment, or a summary of the interaction written by the model. Each has a different failure mode.

Self-generated text is the most available and the most dangerous, because it is exactly the channel through which a bad decision propagates into the weights. Environment feedback is grounded but sparse or delayed. Summaries compress a long history into something trainable but inherit the summarizer’s errors. The weighting applies to all three.

The evaluation puts that difference under pressure by contrasting immediate with delayed feedback. ALFWorld returns a household-task signal after each action; SWE-bench Lite only verifies once a patch is written and the tests run. A method that learns from repetition should behave differently in the second setting, where the same code can be retried many times before any verdict arrives.
pz: 把什么算作经验是另一个独立的设计选择。论文把更新信号当作变量处理：智能体自己生成的轨迹、环境返回的观测，或模型自己撰写的交互摘要。三者的失效方式并不相同。
自生成文本最容易获得，也最危险——错误的决策正是通过这条通道进入权重。环境反馈有事实依据，但可能稀疏或延迟。摘要把长历史压缩成可训练的形式，却继承了摘要器本身的错误。加权机制对三者同样适用。
评测用即时反馈与延迟反馈的对照放大了这种差异：ALFWorld 在每个动作之后立刻给出家居任务信号，SWE-bench Lite 只在补丁写完、测试跑完之后才验证。依赖重复性筛选的方法在第二种场景下应当表现不同，因为同一段代码可能在任何判决出现之前被反复尝试。

sections.h: What the gains are, and what they are not
sections.hz: 收益是什么，又不是什么
p: Baselines cover the obvious alternatives: ReAct with no adaptation at all, static adaptation computed before the rollout, and unfiltered online training that updates on everything. A fourth comparison drops whole repeated updates instead of reweighting tokens inside them — the coarse version of the same idea.

Unfiltered training is the telling baseline because it isolates the cost of ignoring novelty. Dropping entire updates is the other natural remedy and is strictly blunter: an update can be partly repetitive and still contain the one new observation that matters. aTTT keeps that observation and discounts only the repeated part.

The reported improvements — up to 5.0 points on ALFWorld and 4.9 on SWE-bench Lite, averaged over three seeds — come with a caveat the authors draw themselves. Gains concentrate on tasks within the model’s existing competence. aTTT preserves a capability that long trajectories erode; on this evidence it does not teach a capability the model lacked.
pz: 基线覆盖了几种显而易见的替代方案：完全不适配的 ReAct、在 rollout 之前算好的静态适配，以及什么都学的无过滤在线训练。第四组对照直接丢弃重复的整次更新，而不是在更新内部重新加权 token——这是同一思路的粗粒度版本。
无过滤训练最能说明问题，它把忽略新颖性的代价单独剥离出来。丢弃整次更新是另一种自然的补救，但明显更粗暴：一次更新可能部分是重复的，却仍含有唯一重要的新观测。aTTT 保留这个观测，只对重复部分打折。
三个随机种子下的结果（ALFWorld 最高 +5.0、SWE-bench Lite +4.9）附带一个作者自己给出的限定：收益集中在模型已有能力范围内的任务。aTTT 保住的是长轨迹会侵蚀掉的能力；就现有证据而言，它并没有教会模型原本不具备的能力。

sections.h: Preserving competence is not recursive self-improvement
sections.hz: 保住能力不等于递归自我改进
p: The honest framing is narrower than the RSI reading suggests. This is a bounded mechanism for keeping behaviour intact inside one episode, with per-episode LoRA adapters reset between tasks so that nothing accumulates across the benchmark.

That design choice determines the interpretation. If improvements carried across tasks, you would be looking at learning; because adapters are reset, what is measured is resistance to drift. The 1.9× overhead is the price of that resistance, and it is a serving cost as much as a training one — the runtime LoRA updates have to happen while the episode is live.

The open question is whether novelty is the right proxy. Token-level n-gram repetition is cheap and works here, but it cannot distinguish productive exploration from irrelevant variation: a genuinely new wrong turn and a genuinely new useful observation look identical to the filter. A better measure of whether an episode is still producing information would turn this from a safeguard into an adaptation signal.
pz: 准确的定位比 RSI 式解读要窄得多。这是一种让单个回合内的行为保持完整的有限机制：每个回合使用独立的 LoRA 适配器，任务之间重置，因此不会在基准上累积。
这个设计决定了结果如何被解读。若提升能跨任务保留，那才是学习；因为适配器被重置，测得的其实是抗漂移能力。1.9 倍开销就是这种抗性的价格，而且它既是训练代价也是服务代价——运行时 LoRA 更新必须在回合进行中完成。
尚未解决的问题是：新颖性是不是正确的代理指标。token 级 n-gram 重复便宜且在此有效，却无法区分有产出的探索与无关的变化——一次全新的错误尝试和一条全新的有用观测，在过滤器看来完全一样。若能更好地判断一个回合是否仍在产出信息，这套机制就能从兜底手段变成真正的适配信号。

mmg2skill.headline: RSI: From human guides to self-evolving skills
mmg2skill.headlineZh: RSI：从人类指南到自我演化的技能
mmg2skill.dek: Web tutorials are written for people. Turning them into something an agent can execute, diagnose and revise is a separate problem.
mmg2skill.dekZh: 网络教程是写给人看的。让智能体能够执行、诊断并修订它们，是一个独立的问题。

keypoints.en: A guide is not a skill: tutorials assume a human executor, mix text with images and leave recovery steps implicit. The framework compiles them into an editable procedure instead of prompting with the raw text.
keypoints.zh: 指南不等于技能：教程假定执行者是人，图文混杂，恢复步骤隐含不写。该框架把指南编译成可编辑的流程，而不是把原文直接塞进提示词。

keypoints.en: Revision is driven by trajectory-level root-cause analysis, never by benchmark scores, and the vision-language model is never updated — everything learned lives in the skill library.
keypoints.zh: 修订由轨迹级的根因分析驱动，从不使用基准分数；视觉语言模型始终不更新——学到的东西全部存放在技能库中。

keypoints.en: Raw guides can actively hurt. Prompting with the unprocessed guide degrades performance, while structured construction and trajectory-driven revision are each necessary for the +12.8 to +25.3 point macro-average gains.
keypoints.zh: 原始指南可能起反作用：直接用未处理教程提示会拉低表现；结构化构建与轨迹驱动修订各自都是 +12.8 到 +25.3 点宏观平均增益的必要条件。

p: The web is full of instructions for doing things and almost none of them were written for machines. A tutorial says drag it until it snaps, shows a screenshot instead of naming the element, and assumes you will notice when a step has failed. Hand that text to an agent and you have given it reading material, not a procedure.

The gap is not about retrieval or length, it is about form. A guide describes a goal; a skill has to be a sequence the agent can execute, check, and repair when the environment disagrees. MMG2Skill names this guide-to-skill learning and treats the conversion itself — not the final score — as the thing worth studying.

Its answer is a closed loop over an editable artifact. Guides are compiled into skills, the skills condition a fixed vision-language agent during execution, and a trajectory-level analyzer rewrites them afterwards. Across GUI control, open-ended gameplay and strategic card play with six backbones, the macro-average gain is 12.8 to 25.3 percentage points.
pz: 网络上到处都是教人做事的说明，而几乎没有一种是写给机器看的。教程说拖到吸附为止，用截图代替元素名称，并默认你能察觉某一步失败了。把这样的文本交给智能体，你给的是阅读材料，不是可执行流程。
差距不在检索或长度，而在形式。指南描述的是一个目标，技能则必须是一串智能体可以执行、可以校验、并在环境不符合预期时能够修复的步骤。MMG2Skill 把这件事命名为 guide-to-skill learning，并把转换过程本身——而不是最终分数——当作值得研究的对象。
它的解法是围绕一个可编辑产物建立闭环：指南被编译成技能，技能在推理时约束一个固定的视觉语言智能体，轨迹级分析器随后改写技能。在 GUI 控制、开放式游戏与策略卡牌三类任务、六个骨干模型上，宏观平均增益为 12.8 到 25.3 个百分点。

sections.h: What a skill has to be
p: The design constraint is editability. If the learned artifact is a note in natural language, there is no well-defined operation for fixing the step that failed. If it is a structured procedure, a failed attempt can be traced to a specific instruction and that instruction can be changed.

This is also why the vision-language model stays frozen. Weight updates would make the improvement uninterpretable and would confound two different claims — that the agent got better, and that the procedure got better. With a fixed backbone, whatever changes is the skill text, and you can read it.

Construction is therefore a translation problem with a target format. Multimodal guides — screenshots, annotated images, surrounding prose — have to be collapsed into a procedure that refers to what the agent can actually perceive and act on. Prerequisites a human reader infers have to be made explicit, because the executor will not infer them.
pz: 设计上的硬约束是可编辑性。如果学到的产物是一段自然语言笔记，那么修复失败的步骤就没有定义良好的操作；如果它是一份结构化流程，失败的尝试就能定位到某条具体指令，而那条指令可以被改写。
这也是视觉语言模型保持冻结的原因。更新权重会让改进变得不可解释，并把两个不同的论断混在一起——智能体变强了，还是流程变好了。骨干固定时，变化的内容只有技能文本，而它是可以读的。
因此构建是一项有目标格式的翻译任务。多模态指南——截图、标注图、周围正文——必须被压缩成一份只引用智能体真正能感知和操作的对象的流程。人类读者会自行补全的前置条件必须写明，因为执行者不会自行补全。

sections.h: Closing the loop on the agent’s own trajectories
sections.hz: 用智能体自己的轨迹闭合环路
p: After execution, the analyzer reads the trajectory, asks what actually went wrong, and edits the skill accordingly. The feedback is deliberately not the benchmark score: a pass/fail number cannot say which step caused the failure, and using it would tie the skill library to the evaluation set.

The same backbone is used for construction, execution, analysis and refinement. That is a control as much as a convenience — a stronger external teacher doing the analysis would make it impossible to tell whether the gains come from the loop or from the teacher.

MMG2Skill-Bench supplies the testbed across GUI tasks, gameplay and strategic card play, the last of which adds private information the agent cannot observe. That setting is analysed separately, and for a reason: if the decisive information is hidden, no amount of trajectory analysis can recover the true cause of a failure.
pz: 执行之后，分析器读取轨迹，判断究竟哪里出了问题，并据此修改技能。反馈刻意不使用基准分数：一个通过与失败的二进制数无法说明是哪一步造成的失败，而且使用它会把技能库绑定到评测集上。
构建、执行、分析与精修使用同一个骨干模型。这既是便利也是对照——若由一个更强的外部教师来做分析，就无法分辨收益来自闭环还是来自教师。
MMG2Skill-Bench 提供了覆盖 GUI 任务、游戏与策略卡牌的测试平台，最后一类还引入了智能体无法观测的私有信息。这个场景被单独分析是有原因的：如果决定性信息是隐藏的，再多的轨迹分析也无法还原失败的真正原因。

p: Main results compare three conditions — no skills, raw guides, and the full loop — averaged over six backbones with five attempts allowed and the analyzer’s early-stop decision in force. Every model-domain setting improves, with macro-average gains between 12.8 and 25.3 points.

The most informative ablation is the one that fails. Prompting with raw guides can reduce performance: unstructured instructions add noise and misleading detail, and the agent has no way to tell which part of a tutorial applies to the state it is in. Structure is doing real work, not re-tokenising the same content.

Removing revision removes the rest of the gain, which separates the two contributions cleanly. Early stopping is a third and separate effect: when the success signal is calibrated, the analyzer can stop before the attempt budget is spent, saving 25%–53% of attempts and avoiding the late-stage regressions that come from continuing to edit an already-correct skill.
pz: 主实验比较三种条件——无技能、原始指南、完整闭环——在六个骨干模型上取平均，允许五次尝试并启用分析器的早停判断。每一个模型与领域的组合都有提升，宏观平均增益在 12.8 到 25.3 个点之间。
最能说明问题的消融是那个失败的情形。直接用原始指南提示会降低表现：非结构化的说明带来噪声和误导性细节，而智能体无法判断教程的哪一部分适用于当前状态。结构本身在做实质工作，而不是把同样的内容重新切词。
去掉修订就去掉了剩余的增益，这把两者的贡献干净地分开。早停是第三个独立效应：当成功信号经过校准，分析器可以在尝试预算耗尽之前停止，节省 25%–53% 的尝试次数，并避免继续修改一个已经正确的技能所导致的后期退化。

sections.h: An improvement you can read, and one that can be misled
sections.hz: 可读的改进，也会被引偏的改进
p: Because nothing is written into the weights, this is self-improvement in a form you can audit. Given a failing run you can point to the instruction that changed and to the trajectory that caused the change. For deployment, that traceability is often worth more than the raw score.

The corresponding weakness is calibration. An analyzer that declares success too early will preserve a skill that happened to work once, and the procedure stops evolving. The paper’s caveat is precise: early stopping helps when the success signal is properly calibrated, which is a property of the environment rather than of the method.

That is the boundary to carry away. Where the outcome is observable from the trajectory, the loop closes and the skill library compounds. Where decisive information is hidden — a card the agent cannot see, a server state it cannot query — root-cause analysis is guessing, and the honest expectation is no gain rather than a smaller one.
pz: 由于没有任何内容被写入权重，这是一种可以审计的自我改进形式。给定一次失败的运行，你能指出哪条指令被改了、以及是哪条轨迹导致了这次修改。对部署而言，这种可追溯性往往比裸分数更有价值。
相应的弱点在校准。一个过早宣布成功的分析器会保留下某个碰巧奏效过一次的技能，流程就此停止演化。论文的限定说得很准：早停只在成功信号经过恰当校准时才有帮助，而这属于环境的性质，不属于方法的性质。
这是需要带走的边界。当结果可以从轨迹中观测时，闭环成立，技能库持续积累；当决定性信息被隐藏——智能体看不到的一张牌、查不到的服务端状态——根因分析就是在猜测，此时诚实的预期是没有增益，而不是增益变小。

webcompass.headline: Evaluating the whole web-coding workflow
webcompass.headlineZh: 评估完整的网页编程工作流
webcompass.dek: A page can be valid code and still be unusable. WebCompass scores generation, editing and repair by running the result in a browser.
webcompass.dekZh: 一个页面可以代码合法却依然不可用。WebCompass 通过在浏览器中运行产物来评测生成、编辑与修复。

keypoints.en: Seven task categories from three input modalities × three task types, covering 15 generation domains, 16 editing operation types and 11 repair defect types, each graded Easy / Medium / Hard.
keypoints.zh: 三种输入模态 × 三类任务构成七个任务类别，覆盖 15 个生成领域、16 类编辑操作与 11 类修复缺陷，每个实例标注简单 / 中等 / 困难。

keypoints.en: Generation is scored by an Agent-as-a-Judge that launches the site in a real browser, explores interactions through Chrome DevTools MCP and writes targeted test cases — acceptance testing rather than code review.
keypoints.zh: 生成任务由 Agent-as-a-Judge 打分：在真实浏览器中启动站点、通过 Chrome DevTools MCP 探索交互并编写针对性测试用例——这是验收测试，不是代码审查。

keypoints.en: Across ten multimodal models, closed-source stays stronger and more balanced; aesthetics is the most persistent bottleneck, especially for open-source; and framework choice materially moves the score, with Vue consistently hard.
keypoints.zh: 在十个多模态模型上，闭源模型更强也更均衡；美观是最持久的瓶颈，对开源模型尤甚；框架选择显著影响分数，Vue 始终偏难。

p: A generated page can be syntactically valid, pass every static check, and still be unusable: the layout collapses at another viewport, the button does nothing, the form silently discards input. Static correctness metrics were never designed to see any of that.

Web engineering is also not a single act. A site is generated, then changed, then repaired, and most of the real cost sits in the second and third. Benchmarks that score only one-shot text-to-code generation measure the easiest part of the job and report it as the whole.

WebCompass is built around that gap. It spans three input modalities — text, image, video — and three task types — generation, editing, repair — giving seven categories, and it judges generation by actually driving the site in a browser instead of reading its source.
pz: 一个生成的页面可以语法合法、通过所有静态检查，却依然不可用：换个视口布局就塌了，按钮点不动，表单静默丢弃输入。静态正确性指标从来不是为发现这些而设计的。
网页工程也不是一个单一动作。站点先被生成，再被修改，然后被修复，而真实的成本大多落在后两者。只评测一次性文本生成代码的基准，测的是这项工作里最容易的部分，却把它当成全部。
WebCompass 正是围绕这个缺口构建的。它覆盖三种输入模态——文本、图像、视频——与三类任务——生成、编辑、修复——构成七个类别，并通过在浏览器中真实驱动站点、而非阅读源码来评判生成质量。

p: The three task types are not three difficulties of the same skill. Generation asks whether something works at all. Editing asks whether a requested change lands without breaking everything the request did not mention. Repair asks whether a specific defect is fixed without losing interactions that already worked.

That last clause is where most repairs fail. A fix can remove the bug and take the hover state, the keyboard path and the error message with it. Scoring repair only on whether the defect is gone would reward exactly that trade.

Editing and repair are judged with checklist-guided evaluation, which is the right tool when the intended change is known in advance: the checklist states what must hold, and the judge checks each item instead of forming a global impression. Generation has no such list, which is why it needs a different mechanism.
pz: 三类任务并不是同一技能的三种难度。生成问的是做出来的东西能不能跑；编辑问的是要求的改动能否落地，同时不破坏需求里没提到的其他部分；修复问的是某个具体缺陷是否被修掉，同时不丢失原本已经可用的交互。
后一个限定正是大多数修复失败的地方。一次修改可以移除缺陷，同时把悬浮态、键盘路径和错误提示一起带走。如果只按缺陷是否消失来打分，就等于在奖励这种交换。
编辑与修复采用清单引导式评测，这在预期改动事先已知时是正确的工具：清单写明必须成立的条件，评判者逐项核对，而不是形成一个整体印象。生成任务没有这样的清单，因此需要另一套机制。

sections.h: Executing the page instead of reading it
sections.hz: 运行页面，而不是阅读页面
p: For generation, WebCompass uses an agent as the judge. It loads the produced site in a real browser, navigates it, triggers interactions through Chrome DevTools MCP, and iteratively writes test cases against what it finds. The result resembles a QA engineer’s acceptance run more than a code review.

This matters because a screenshot is a state, not a behaviour. Two screenshots can look identical while one belongs to a page whose filter works and the other to a page whose filter silently does nothing. Only execution separates them.

The evaluation keeps three dimensions separate — can the site run, does it meet the requirement, does it look right — and averages nine scores overall. Ten multimodal models are tested through Claude Code 2.0.67, with further analyses on difficulty, framework and thinking mode.
pz: 对生成任务，WebCompass 用一个智能体充当评判者：在真实浏览器中加载产出的站点、浏览它、通过 Chrome DevTools MCP 触发交互，并针对发现的问题迭代编写测试用例。这更接近 QA 工程师的验收流程，而非代码审查。
这一点很关键，因为截图是状态，不是行为。两张截图可能看起来完全一样，但一张属于筛选功能可用的页面，另一张属于筛选功能静默失效的页面。只有运行才能把它们区分开。
评测把三个维度分开处理——站点能否运行、是否满足需求、是否好看——并综合九个分数。十个多模态模型通过 Claude Code 2.0.67 测试，另附难度、框架与思考模式的进一步分析。

p: Closed-source models are stronger and, more tellingly, more balanced. Open-source entries tend to show a sharp profile, with one or two dimensions carrying the score while the others lag — a shape that a single aggregate number would flatten into an average.

Aesthetics is the persistent bottleneck and it is not close. Models that produce functioning applications still produce plainly unattractive ones, and the gap is widest for open-source models — a reminder that visual quality is a separate capability from code correctness, not a cosmetic add-on to it.

Two secondary findings are easy to lose in a ranking. Editing and repair have distinct difficulty profiles: repair tends to preserve interactivity better but remains harder to execute. And framework choice materially moves the score, with Vue consistently challenging and React or Vanilla/HTML stronger depending on the task — so part of a model’s web-coding score is really a fact about its default stack.
pz: 闭源模型更强，更能说明问题的是也更均衡。开源模型往往呈现尖锐的能力剖面：一两个维度撑起分数，其余维度落后——而这种形状会被一个综合数字抹平成平均值。
美观是最持久的瓶颈，而且差距不小。能够产出可运行应用的模型，仍然会产出明显不好看的应用，开源模型上的差距最大。这提醒我们：视觉质量是与代码正确性并列的一项独立能力，而不是后者的装饰性附属。
两个次要发现在排名里很容易丢失。编辑与修复的难度剖面不同：修复往往更好地保留了交互性，但执行起来更难。框架选择也实质性地改变分数——Vue 始终偏难，React 与原生 HTML 则视任务类型更强——因此一个模型的网页编程分数里，有一部分其实是在反映它默认的技术栈。

sections.h: Reading a benchmark as a profile
sections.hz: 把基准当作能力剖面来读
p: The practical instruction is to stop treating web coding as one number. Runability, requirement adherence and visual quality fail independently, and a model can be excellent at two and unacceptable at the third.

The benchmark’s own limits should travel with its scores. Judges are automated, so dimension-level results inherit the judge’s blind spots, and a real browser runtime ties the measurement to one environment. A single aggregate ranking compresses both away.

The larger point is about what working means for generated software. Correct code is a precondition, not a deliverable. If evaluation only checks the precondition, training will optimise for it, and the thing users actually judge — whether the product works and looks right — stays unmeasured.
pz: 实践上的建议是：别再把网页编程当作一个数字。可运行性、需求符合度与视觉质量会各自独立地失败，一个模型完全可能在前两项上出色、在第三项上不可接受。
基准自身的局限应当随分数一起被引用。评判是自动的，因此维度级结果会继承评判者的盲区；真实浏览器运行时又把测量绑定在某一个环境上。一个综合排名会把这两者都压缩掉。
更根本的一点在于：对生成的软件而言，可用意味着什么。正确的代码是前提，不是交付物。如果评测只检查前提，训练就会去优化前提，而用户真正在意的——产品是否可用、是否好看——将持续处于无测量的状态。
